Promptly reports any observed workplace hazards, and any injury, occupational illness, and/or property damage resulting from workplace mishaps to the immediate supervisor.

Four years of experience that demonstrates knowledge and experience in applying the principles, methods, techniques and theories of field engineering as well as all phases of project planning and estimating so as to oversee the management and administration of various construction projects which would be funded with either appropriated (APF) or non-appropriated (NAF) funds.

About InAir
InAir is a forward-thinking, fully remote consulting firm with a stronghold in Texas. We are proud experts in Airtable consulting services, partnering with mid-sized to large enterprises. Our mission is to harness the power of low-code platforms, enabling businesses to optimize their workflows, foster collaboration, and achieve ambitious outcomes through Airtable.
At our company, we foster a culture of honesty, responsibility, and accountability. These core values create a successful, innovative, and transparent workplace. Our remote work setting is built on trust, respect, and open communication, allowing team members to shine and grow.

We're looking for a Technical Project Manager to own client projects from first discovery call to final delivery — with a twist: this is a hands-on role. You won't just manage the work; you'll build a significant part of it yourself in Airtable.
Think of it as the intersection of three skills: understanding how a business operates, managing a project to done, and configuring the system with your own hands. If you've ever been the person at your company who "figured out the tools" and ended up running the whole process, this role was built for you.
A dedicated Engineer covers custom code — you cover everything else: the client, the plan, and the build.

Own the client: Be the primary point of contact for a portfolio of enterprise clients. Lead discovery, manage expectations, and turn business goals into concrete requirements.
Run the project: Own scope, priorities, and timelines. Coordinate day-to-day execution with our Engineer and keep momentum consistent across accounts.
Build in Airtable: Configure tables, automations, and interfaces yourself. You're not writing code, but you are building the system.
Make systems better: Review existing client implementations and improve their structure, usability, and scalability.

Project leadership with your hands in the work. Experience running client-facing or cross-functional projects where you also built or configured the solution — not just tracked tickets.
A power-user profile. You've mastered tools like Airtable, Notion, Asana, HubSpot, Zapier, or similar — deeply enough to design processes in them, not just use them.
Comfort with structured data. You get how tables relate to each other and why clean structure keeps a growing system from breaking. Formal database training is a plus rather than a prerequisite.
Strong communication. You can lead a meeting with executives and translate between business and technical worlds.
Accountability. You own outcomes across multiple projects at once and don't wait to be told what's next.

Airtable experience (a big plus — but we'll train the right builder).
Background in consulting, agencies, RevOps, or operations.
Familiarity with the low-code/no-code ecosystem.
Experience with ClickUp.
Structure & Availability
Full-time (40 hours/week), fully remote. This is a core client-facing role: you'll need stable, dedicated availability aligned with US business hours.

Establish clear decision-making and change-control processes with customers and suppliers.

Ensure that hardware, software, AIT documentation, procedures, readiness reviews, test configurations remain properly controlled and traceable.

Monitor supplier readiness, deliveries, technical maturity and documentation.
Define clear AIT acceptance criteria and deliverables for suppliers.
Lead supplier recovery actions when technical mistakes or late deliveries threaten the schedule or mission.

Experience in AIT, AIV, system integration, verification or test campaign leadership.

Strong technical background in spacecraft AIT, system engineering and requirements verification.
Experience with environmental testing, test facilities, ground support equipment and launch-site activities.
Demonstrated experience in budget management, resource allocation, schedule control and risk mitigation.
Strong supplier-management and problem-solving skills.
Excellent leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multidisciplinary teams.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Willingness to travel frequently, mostly across Europe.

At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come.

Join Roche, where every voice matters.The PositionIn Roche-s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organisation (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients to tackle some of the world-s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines.

Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed.At the intersection of science and innovation, pRED-s Pharmaceutical Sciences (PS) organisation enables the discovery and development of safe and effective therapeutics at optimal doses in relevant populations with a vision to power translation, continuously improve the accuracy of our predictions and accelerate the development of tomorrow's medicines.

By seamlessly integrating our three core pillars-Translational Safety, Translational Pharmacology, and Biomarkers-we drive end-to-end asset development across the entire value chain, from target assessment to on-market support.

Our mission is to continuously improve predictive accuracy, optimise dosing strategies for the right patient populations, and accelerate the development of tomorrow's safe and effective therapeutics.

The OpportunityAs an experienced DMPK-PD Project Leader within the Translational DMPK-PD Group, you will be pivotal in ensuring the right drug is delivered at the right dose, safely and efficaciously, to patients.

You will lead nonclinical and translational strategies, collaborating across therapeutic areas to transform scientific hypotheses into groundbreaking clinical candidates.Your Impact & Responsibilities:Strategy & Design: Define and lead drug design and optimisation strategies and compound profiling integrating cutting-edge Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) principles, with a strong focus on target biology validation and translational PK/Pharmacodynamics (PD) concepts.Translational Expertise: Serve as the subject matter expert, guiding early discovery teams in developing sophisticated translational strategies for clinical evaluation of target modulation, leveraging deep biochemical and pharmacological knowledge.Modelling & Simulation (M&S): Execute fundamental M&S activities, including PKPD, Physiologically-Based Pharmacokinetics (PBPK), Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI), and human dose/regimen prediction, to provide essential support for projects spanning from Lead Optimisation (LO) through early and late-stage clinical development (EIH, Ph 2/3).Regulatory Mastery: Author and present definitive, high-quality scientific assessments of non-clinical DMPK data for critical internal program reviews and all major external regulatory submissions (IND, IB, CTA, NDA, BLA), ensuring global compliance and accelerated timelines.Implementation: Implement biomarker and bioanalytical strategies in close collaboration with key partners to ensure both patient safety and the achievement of meaningful therapeutic benefit.Cross-Functional Influence: Champion transparent, data-driven decision-making, acting as a trusted advisor and cultivating high-trust professional relationships across global project teams, governance bodies, and external partnerships.Who You AreYou hold a PharmD or PhD in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmacology, Bioengineering or similar, coupled with over 5-10 years of industry experience in a pharmacokinetic-related roleYou possess deep, comprehensive expertise across the entire discovery preclinical and development spectrum, covering PK characterisation, distribution, and PKPD for diverse modalities (small molecules, biologics, nucleic acid-based therapeutics), grounded in authoritative knowledge of pharmacology and physiology.You demonstrate hands-on experience with modelling and simulation, proficiency in applying Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to DMPK strategy, and a strong drive to master tools like Phoenix, Berkeley Madonna, GastroPlus, or SimCyp.You combine an excellent understanding of PK/PD with strong communication skills and proven leadership experience to guide complex projects in a multi-disciplinary environment.You are accountable for defining and delivering clear outcomes, possessing the ability to transcend organisational boundaries to address or escalate issues effectively.You are an inclusive, authentic leader who actively seeks diversity and fosters a high-trust, high-performance environment where every team member is empowered to contribute their best.At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions.

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products.

We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.Let-s build a healthier future, together.Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About Wolt
At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation.

Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance).

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching
Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.
Stakeholder Engagement
Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.
Flow metrics trend (cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress) shared and improving over time.
Time-to-resolution on escalated risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.
Stakeholder-reported clarity and trust in delivery commitments (Business Owners, executive sponsors).
Team-reported psychological safety and agile maturity progression.

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of customer projects and service engagements by aligning resource capacity with customer demand, driving project execution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met. This role serves as the operational hub between customers, delivery teams, project resources, and leadership to ensure projects are properly staffed, risks are proactively managed, and customer expectations are consistently achieved.
The Service Delivery Manager oversees project governance, resource planning, meeting facilitation, action item management, and escalation resolution while maintaining visibility into project health, resource utilization, timelines, budgets, and overall customer satisfaction.
You will lead end-to-end delivery of Palantir-based programs, ensuring alignment between stakeholders, timelines, and technical teams. Role Description
Resource Management & Capacity Planning
Maintain visibility into all available service delivery resources and project assignments.
Align inbound project demand with available resource capacity and skill sets.
Coordinate resource assignments across multiple customer engagements and projects.
Monitor resource utilization and recommend adjustments to optimize delivery performance.
Identify resource constraints and skill gaps and develop mitigation plans.
Partner with delivery leaders and functional managers on staffing priorities and future resource needs.
Project Delivery & Execution
Track all incoming projects and service engagements from initiation through completion.
Ensure projects are appropriately staffed and aligned to customer requirements.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and deliverables.
Facilitate project status meetings, delivery reviews, and customer update meetings.
Ensure projects remain on track and proactively address obstacles impacting delivery.
Support project teams in developing and executing recovery plans when necessary.
Governance & Accountability
Facilitate recurring project and operational review meetings.
Document meeting outcomes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.
Distribute meeting notes within established timelines.
Track action items through completion and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.
Maintain project dashboards, status reports, risk logs, and delivery metrics.
Ensure consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.
Risk & Escalation Management
Identify and manage project risks related to scope, budget, timeline, resources, and technical dependencies.
Maintain risk and issue logs for active projects.
Work with project teams to develop mitigation plans and corrective actions.
Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.
Drive issue resolution while maintaining alignment among stakeholders.
Escalate significant risks and concerns to leadership when appropriate.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams.
Provide clear communication regarding project status, risks, resource challenges, and delivery commitments.
Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities and delivery challenges.
Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication and successful execution.
Ensure customer expectations are aligned with project objectives and delivery capabilities.

Negotiation: Can identify opportunities for compromise, propose solutions, and take action to influence outcomes without explicit instructions.
Initiative: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose solutions, and take action without explicit instructions.

Suchst du eine Herausforderung im Umfeld von Politik und Verwaltung, am digitalen Puls der Zeit, bei einer Arbeitgeberin mit Themen so vielfältig wie das Leben?
Die Direktion der Justiz und des Innern (JI) erfüllt eine Vielfalt von Aufgaben, von A wie Archivwesen bis Z wie Zivilstandswesen. Bei uns im Generalsekretariat laufen die Fäden zusammen. Wir unterstützen die Direktionsvorsteherin und unsere Einheiten, bearbeiten Querschnittsthemen und begleiten und führen Programme und Projekte.
Im Januar 2027 tritt das revidierte Verwaltungsrechtspflegegesetz in Kraft, das vorsieht, dass Verwaltungsverfahren neu auch digital über spezielle elektronische Kanäle abgewickelt werden. Mit RRB Nr. 433/2026 wurde ein wichtiger Meilenstein für die Implementierung dieser elektronischen Kanäle im Kanton Zürich erreicht: Im Projekt VRGo wird die neue technische Lösung «VerfahrenZH» aufgebaut, welche die rechtskonforme Abwicklung von Verwaltungsverfahren ermöglicht.
Um den organisationsübergreifenden Aufbau dieser Lösung seitens der JI zu begleiten, und um im Betrieb der Lösung die Anforderungen unserer Verwaltungseinheiten fachgerecht bei den zuständigen Stellen einzubringen, suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung im Generalsekretariat eine Person mit technischem Hintergrund als Manager/in digitale Kanäle (80 - 100 %).
### Deine Hauptaufgaben ###
* Du stehst proaktiv im Austausch mit den verfahrensführenden Stellen der JI und identifizierst, koordinierst und priorisierst ihre Anforderungen an die elektronischen Kanäle. Diese bringst du in die Projekte zu deren Weiterentwicklung und in übergreifende Digitalisierungsvorhaben ein.
* Du kennst die relevanten Fachapplikationen der JI und unterstützt allfällige Weiterentwicklungen und Anbindungen in Zusammenhang mit den elektronischen Kanälen.
* Du bist in der JI, im Kanton und im Bund mit den relevanten Stellen vernetzt und über bedeutsame Entwicklungen auf dem Laufenden.
* Du berätst und unterstützt die Verwaltungseinheiten der JI bei der weiteren Digitalisierung ihrer Verwaltungsverfahren. Dazu begleitest du die Umsetzung neuer oder weiterentwickelter Funktionalitäten aus Nutzendensicht und stehst in engem Austausch mit den Fachbereichen, Legal, IT-/Betriebsteams und weiteren Stakeholdern.
### Dein Profil ###
* Tertiäre Ausbildung (z.B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Rechtswissenschaften), mit Erfahrung in der Digitalisierung von Prozessen, Dienstleistungen oder Kommunikationskanälen (vorzugsweise in der Verwaltung oder im juristischen Bereich)
* Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse der Nutzenden sowie für serviceorientierte Gestaltung, stark in Koordination und Stakeholder-Management
* Schnelle Auffassungsgabe sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise mit Freude an der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung digitaler Lösungen
* Ganzheitliches Denken, hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, Eigeninitiative und hohe Eigenverantwortung mit proaktivem Arbeitsverständnis

Schick uns deine Bewerbung direkt über unser Online-Tool (für diese Stelle berücksichtigen wir keine Bewerbungen über Personaldienstleistungsunternehmen). Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Samuel Klaus, Leiter Recht Digital, wenden (043 259 25 43, samuel.klaus@ji.zh.ch).

Pourquoi ce poste est fait pour toi?
Tu as envie de comprendre aussi bien l’aspect technique que le business sales. Tu souhaite réfléchir à la configuration et aux solutions avec les devs ET parler efficacité commerciale avec les sales managers.
Le contexte
Ce poste fait partie de Sales Strategy & Operations, l'équipe centrale qui pilote toute la stratégie revenue de Pennylane. C'est une équipe de 10 personnes, et tu participeras au succès et de la scalabilité de notre machine commerciale.
Le poste
L’objectif est de devenir une source d’informations et solutions pour l’équipe Sales, les débloquer, et les rendre toujours plus efficaces.
Pour cela, tu vas aider à comprendre leurs contraintes, prioriser, et piloter les projets qui impactent vraiment leur productivité (configurations Salesforce, intégrations outils, optimisations, IA...).
Avec une forte dimension apprentissage et projet, tu vas monter progressivement en expertise sur notre stack (Salesforce, Modjo, ChiliPiper, Ringover, Dust...) et devenir clé pour que l'équipe Sales scale efficacement.
Missions principales
Tu seras le point de référence technique pour l'équipe Sales (100+ personnes) sur tous les sujets CRM et outils commerciaux. Tes responsabilités principales:
Comprendre les besoins des équipes Sales - Identifier les problématiques qui ralentissent ou limitent les commerciaux (productivité Salesforce, workflow d'appels, pipeline accuracy...)
Qualifier et prioriser - Challenger les demandes, saisir ce qui a vrai impact, et prioriser avec le reste de l'équipe Sales Strat & Ops
Piloter les projets - De la spécification à la mise en production : cadrer, planifier, coordonner avec l'équipe tech, tester, communiquer, et accompagner la conduite du changement
Supporter les utilisateurs - Assurer un support efficace et scalable sur Salesforce et les outils satellites. Identifier les patterns et les opportunités d'optimisation.
Monter en expertise - Apprendre progressivement les méthodologies de gestion de projet, l’analyse data, Salesforce et comment les équipes commerciales fonctionnent vraiment.
Note: Nous cherchons quelqu'un avec le goût d'apprendre, pas quelqu'un qui sait déjà tout!
Profil recherché
Junior avec une petite expérience (1-2 ans) OU profil en transition vers les outils CRM/Sales Ops
Profil technico-fonctionnel - à l'aise aussi bien avec le technique qu'avec le métier
Curiosité et soif d'apprendre - tu aimes découvrir et maîtriser de nouveaux outils/concepts
Ouverture d'esprit - tu as envie d’apprendre différentes perspectives (tech ET business)

Screening Interview avec Nathalie - Talent Acquisition - 30 minutes.
Manager Interview avec Maud - Associate Team Lead Technical Partner - 45 minutes.
Business Case direct avec Maud et un autre membre de l'équipe - 1 heure.

The Landscape Manager assists in managing the daily operations of all grounds activities within best organic practices and protocols. This includes identification, diagnosis and recommendations with regard to tree, turf, and shrub health within the organically managed system.

The Landscape Manager works with landscape architects, contractors, arborists, turf technicians, irrigation specialists, machine operators, and staff to provide oversight of the maintenance of the existing landscape of specimen trees, irrigation system, turf, meadows and woodlands and assists in providing direction and supervision for all landscape assets.
This role is based on our private island reserve, Ocean Cay, with staff accommodation provided.

· Create reports to maintain accurate records of maintenance activities.
· Daily ready the campus for guests.

· Open and clear communication with OC Personnel via phone calls, email or in person.
· Maintain high standards of workmanship that adhere to original plans and specifications of OC Leadership.
